content:
infra-bot: alert: multiple apiserver 5xxs and leader-election churn in eu-west1 detected :rotating_light:
joel: noticed apiserver frontends returning 502/503s for ~12m, controller-manager leaders flipping frequently
anya: controller-manager logs: "timed out waiting for leader lease" every 25-40s; parity with apiserver 503 spikes
mike: cloud provider notes a route flap in eu-west1 public subnet 10:32-10:36 causing packet loss to NAT gateways, conntrack + retransmits likely
selena: GPU attach controller shows a backlog: 180 pending attach ops, many in CrashLoopBackOff -> autoscaler repeatedly tries new pods -> watch storm
joel: running quick checks: nat gateway conntrack at 90%, SYN recv rate spiking, apiserver LB showing lots of new TLS handshakes
anya: grep controller-manager: `kubectl -n kube-system logs deploy/controller-manager --since=20m | grep "timed out waiting for leader lease"` -> ~150 matches clustered at 2025-08-18T10:33
mike: provider flagged brief NVMe latency blip on controlplane volumes during same window, maybe unrelated but worth noting: `i/o wait` spikes ~30-50ms
peter: combined effect: route flap -> NAT retries -> conntrack exhaustion -> TLS handshake failures -> apiserver 502s -> controller leader loss. GPU attach retries amplify watch traffic and make it worse
selena: mitigation suggestions: 1) pause autoscaler for 15m in eu-west1 to stop new attach attempts 2) apply exponential backoff to provisioner retries 3) bump conntrack temporarily 4) shift non-critical batch traffic to eu-central
joel: applied temporary autoscaler pause for eu-west1 batch nodegroup via cluster-autoscaler annotation :white_check_mark:
anya: deployed provisioner backoff canary (10s -> 120s) to reduce parallel attaches
mike: requested CAB with cloud provider to confirm NAT route stability, they confirmed route flap resolved at 10:36 and are investigating root cause
peter: bumped conntrack max on NATs 65536->180000 as stopgap; also added iptables SYN rate-limit for provisioner pool
selena: rolling restart of controller-manager replicas sequentially with 45s grace to re-acquire leader lease -> observing fewer lease failures now
joel: still seeing short etcd wal latency spikes; opening ticket to test moving etcd metadata to isolated IO profile if this keeps happening
anya: finance note: estimated monthly delta for isolated NVMe for etcd ~ $1.5k-2.2k depending on region sizing, will send exact numbers
mike: short-term plan: keep autoscaler paused + provisioner backoff + conntrack bump + monitor for 30-45m; if apiserver errors persist, schedule IO migration and full maintenance window
selena: created dashboard with alerts: apiserver_5xx_rate>0.03, conntrack_used>85%, pending_attaches>50, controller_lease_failures>10m
joel: post-incident actions: 1) add provisioner token-bucket to limit parallel attaches 2) reserve a small warm GPU pool for scheduled batch windows 3) add route-flap mitigation playbook with provider contacts
peter: noting that long-term we should reduce dependency on NAT for controlplane egress and consider regional egress gateways with larger conntrack headroom
anya: updating incident log and runbook: incident-ref: route-flap-provisioner-thrash-2025-08-18 :memo:
infra-bot: incident appended to tracker INF-2025-08-18-6
joel: marking thread in-progress, will post metrics update in 10m :coffee:
